profile.response: GetResponse of that route: GeoJSON or tabular profile; only manual-geojson/1 supports this question
profile.trigger: No item.plan, placement needs_answer, sourceId present, stored reason is the no-layout officer-question sentence; successful GeoJSON profile. Other stored reasons keep their words without a form. Never choose from filename.
profile.reasonNow: No approved layout matches this file. An officer states what each feature is and which field identifies it.
profile.legacyReason: No approved layout matches this file. An officer chooses the identifier field.

choices.kind: building | parcel | road | public_land | utility, initially unset
choices.geometry: registry.ts:16-17,71-77: building/parcel/public_land only Polygon/MultiPolygon; road/utility accept Point/MultiPoint/LineString/MultiLineString/Polygon/MultiPolygon. Unknown/empty geometry cannot establish compatibility.
choices.identifier: literalIdEligible only; other fields say repeats, has blanks, or is not text, without claiming which cause
choices.name: literalTextEligible, optional initially Not stated; server may still refuse incompatible name path
choices.height: property path with numbers/text only; optional, initially Not stated; selected height requires unit m|ft and officer meaning 1-500 characters. No guessed values or unit.

author.comparison: Member-for-member KN2 steps.ts:239-264 layout(caseId, retained, {}, 'building', false). No destination member. Height/name omitted for this walk. Pure test evaluates unchanged KN2 function and compares author request.
author.optionalName: third operation feature.name, selected path, literal_text@1
author.optionalHeight: heightField (decoded property name), heightUnit, heightMeaning, all three or none
author.change: expectedRecipeRevision from displayed receipt; prefill exact stored choices; no re-inference
author.approve: POST recipes/{recipeId}/approve with fresh retained requestKey and expectedRecipeRevision from 201 returned receipt. Proposed read-back if approval fails. Each uncertain request resends its same immutable body/key; never author twice after known 201. 409 rereads; 422 stored words beside relevant choice.

refusals.MAPPING_GEOMETRY_KIND: The layout states <kind>, which does not accept <types> geometry. Choose a compatible kind; no kind is inferred.
MAPPING_IDENTITY: Source identity must be complete, unique, nonempty literal text.
Choose a source attribute or retained Feature.id.
refusals.MAPPING_NAME: A name mapping requires a complete text attribute; null and absent values stay distinct in the profile.
MAPPING_HEIGHT: State the height field, its source unit and its meaning together.
Choose an inspected numeric or text height attribute; null and absent values remain unknown.
refusals.MAPPING_DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE: Read exact sentence from intake-destination.ts; show verbatim as general error, never ask for or invent a destination.

parks: KN2 steps.ts:34,247-248 uses parks.geojson, public_land, /features/*/id. Same retained folder, unchanged file; no numeric coercion allowed.

liveCondition.result: fatal: path does not exist in staging
liveCondition.decision: Build/tests continue. At walk step re-check once; only if authoredLayoutReachesRow:true then merge staging once more and walk. Otherwise checkpoint and stop.

subscription: One shared case subscriber per page; tray/layout/recording consumers use same transport and cursor. Last consumer leaving closes it. Bounded reads continue while stream is refused; 429 words obtained from refused stream HTTP response, not guessed.
notOwned: server, contracts, client, scene, area, table, web. Originals and credentials untouched; gateway disabled.
